turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, I guess. A bit tired and my tummy is sore, but I'm awake at least.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate your pain right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe a 4 or 5? It's manageable, but I can feel it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks. Are you feeling any nausea or like you might be sick?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A little bit, but not too bad. I didn't eat anything before, so maybe that helps.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. How's your breathing? Any difficulty or tightness in your chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. Just a bit stuffy from the tube, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Do you remember anything from the operation itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't think so. I was out completely.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected. Lastly, with your diabetes and blood pressure, are you feeling any dizziness or unusual symptoms?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I feel stable. Just a bit thirsty, but I know I can't drink yet.
